static_traits.name: Lin Qing
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可求助，但not yet向他们披露与食物相关的Anxiety与内疚；因回避涉及甜点的Social gatherings，Interpersonal relationships受到影响。
static_traits.medical_history: 此前not yet有类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗；without显著躯体疾病。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能识do not思维的非理性成分；语气谨慎、略显紧张；配合度较好但对谈话疗效持怀疑态度；能具体描述诱发情境与影响。

basic_info.main_problem: 我有一种思维模式，认为频繁吃我最喜欢的甜点布朗尼将not可避免地导致体重增加。这一信念使我在享用布朗尼时产生Anxiety和内疚。
basic_info.core_demands: 持续的关于体重增加的Anxiety与恐惧开始影响我的心理健康和生活质量，因此我寻求咨询；我只希望这种Anxietynot要再控制我的生活。
growth_experiences: 几个月前开始注意到体重增加，在工作截止期压力与个人生活挑战的共同作用下，逐渐形成“吃布朗尼会not可避免增重”的信念；此后在面对食物选择或有甜点的社交场合时Anxiety显著加重，出现内疚与回避，睡眠与自我照料被打乱，并尝试多种节食与高强度运动但效果有限。

core_beliefs: 吃甜点（尤其布朗尼）会not可避免地导致体重增加
要避免变胖就必须严格控制饮食

special_situations.event: 在有甜点的Social gatherings中（例如摆放布朗尼）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 哪怕吃一块也会破坏减重进展，等同失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避参与或拒绝甜点、降低社交频率
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 一块布朗尼就会毁掉我的进展。

special_situations.event: Alone making food choices (deciding whether to eat dessert or a brownie)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not严格限制甜点，就一定会增重
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Follows an extreme diet and high-intensity exercise to offset possible weight gain
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我吃了，就肯定会变胖。

special_situations.event: 回想几个月前注意到体重增加的经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 曾因吃甜点增重说明甜点总会导致增重
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Based on past weight fluctuations, continuously strengthens restriction and monitoring of diet
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I gained weight because of desserts before, so it will definitely be the same in the future.

special_situations.event: 在工作截止期和个人生活Increased stress时出现进食欲望
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Feeling stressed means it is easier to lose control, so restriction must be even stricter
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用更严格的规则（not吃甜点）来应对not安与紧张
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我这么Anxiety，若吃了甜点一定会更糟。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to comfortably enjoy favorite foods while maintaining self-worth and peace of mind
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失控增重与被评价，伴随强烈内疚与Anxiety
defense_goal: 通过严格限制与回避甜点来保持控制、降低Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 容易自责、担心被评判的自我
object_relations.object_representation: 可能not理解或会评价自己的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师提出通过谈话探索与重新框架其Anxiety与信念时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为“谈话帮助not大”，以维持对问题的控制感
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以怀疑与冷淡的语气简短回应，强调“我not觉得这能帮上忙”，回避深入情绪层面讨论。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被邀请探讨向朋友寻求支持与分享困扰时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 预设他人not会理解或会评价自己，从而避免接近与暴露脆弱
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use泛指与推测性的表述（如“他们not会理解”），减少具体细节，维持人际距离与话题表层化。

manifestations: 被严格的饮食规则与对增重的恐惧束缚，难以Freedom地享用喜爱的食物
对甜点的选择感到受限，行为被Anxiety主导
outcomes: Decreased quality of life，自我照料与Sleep disturbed

manifestations: 避免参与涉及甜点的Social gatherings
认为朋友not会理解自己的困扰而选择not披露
outcomes: Strained and distant interpersonal relationships感增加
获得支持的机会减少，Anxiety循环加重

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 在咨询与生活中预设“朋友not会理解我”，因此not披露Anxiety与内疚
以他人可能的评价为由Avoids socializing

manifestations: 在食物选择上高度自我审查与苛责
Skeptical attitude toward the exploration in counseling, cautious expression and reserve

positive_force: Able to notice and point out the counter-evidence that 'not every brownie will immediately cause weight gain'
愿意尝试从not同角度审视思维，接受替代观点的练习
Has a certain self-observation ability, able to describe triggering situations and effects

target_behavior.behavior: 在面对甜点（尤其布朗尼）时产生强烈Anxiety与内疚，并伴随限制/补偿性行为
antecedent: 回想之前体重增加的经历
处于工作截止期与个人生活Increased stress时
target_behavior.core_reason: 对增重的灾难化预测与过度概括（将一次或部分经历推广为必然结果），并以Anxiety情绪当作事实依据（情绪化推理）
target_behavior.function: 逃避被视为not受欢迎的结果（增重与被评价），并短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent anxiety与内疚，睡眠与自我照料受扰，Decreased quality of life

target_behavior.behavior: 回避涉及甜点的社交活动
antecedent: 被邀请参加有甜点的聚会或活动
预想到在场会有布朗尼等甜点
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about losing dietary control in social situations and thus gaining weight or being evaluated by others
target_behavior.function: 逃避诱发Anxiety的线索与潜在的外部评价，维持安全感与控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Strained and distant interpersonal relationships，Reduced social support，Anxiety循环被Reinforcement
